mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(product_id, seller_id, title, subtitle, main_image, category_id, status, sales_count, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted) VALUES (#{productId}, #{sellerId}, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{mainImage}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE product SET sales_count = sales_count + #{quantity}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0
